address: 1 Edwins Hall Cottages, Crows Lane, Woodham Ferrers, Chelmsford, CM3 8RT
description: A two-storey side extension with a new side porch, expanding a home in Woodham Ferrers, Chelmsford.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mr Brewer asked Architecture ONE to extend his home at 1 Edwins Hall Cottages, Crows Lane, Woodham Ferrers, with a two-storey side extension and new side porch.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: The scheme was revised following an initial planning sketch, with a resubmitted design in February 2019 adding the two-storey side extension and porch, with materials matched to the existing cottage.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Chelmsford City Council granted full planning permission for the scheme in April 2019 (application ref. 19/00250/FUL).
